title: Article clues across a paragraph
subtitle: Use the article to connect, identify, and substantivize.
overview: The article can help you find noun phrases, turn modifiers into substantive phrases, and recognize a previously introduced entity.
It is not simply English “the.” Observe position and function before attempting a one-word translation.

sections.title: Article signals
rows: my love, marked as a phrase

items.grc: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με.
items.en: The one who has my commandments and keeps them is the one loving me.

items.grc: τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἦν ἐρχόμενον εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
items.en: The true light was coming into the world.
